body:
Pet Shop: south-east block (east of the middle road, south of the main street).
Space in that block, from the town code (NOT VERIFIED in a picture):
A) Corner east of the Flower Shop
B) Strip south of the apartments
C) Behind the Pet Shop (small, about 6 m)
A has a walking line through it; C has rocks and the apartment path.
Clinic size: unknown (Non-living models).
Left (tool work, sent to Plan): place it in the Area plan, picture for your pick.

comments.text: Karolis in the Map chat, 31 Oct: 'all looks good in map'.
Pictures renewed: the clinic as in the Area plan (x 14.2, z -77.2). The game builds it there.

short: Vet clinic in town at x 14.2, z -77.2 (Karolis's spot, nudged 3.2 m so it touches nothing).
title: Vet clinic spot in town
